cohort: 111 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery at two academic institutions in New York during the reopening phase of the COVID-19 pandemic who had a negative preoperative reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction test and immunoglobulin G antibody test for COVID-19
finding: No nosocomial COVID-19 infections were identified among women undergoing elective cesarean delivery with strict perioperative and postpartum protocols in place.
